tools.name: acc_ui_render
tools.title: Show a component
tools.description: Show the user a rich component described by an acc-ui/1 spec: cards, key/value lists, tables, badges, progress, checklists, callouts, file/PR/commit links, charts, Mermaid diagrams, images, markdown, HTML, and buttons, chips or forms whose answers come back as a user message. Returns at once. Use it for structured results and status; don't repeat its content in text.

oneOf.description: A titled box around its children.
A highlighted note, warning or error.
A file on the host, opened on tap.
A line, bar, area, point or pie chart.
Self-contained HTML in a sandbox: no network, no navigation.
Source code or other preformatted text.
A summary line whose children show when the user opens it.
A button that runs an action when tapped.
Quick-reply chips; each runs its action when tapped.
Input fields with a submit button.

wrap.description: Wrap onto more lines when the row is too narrow.

oneOf.description: Send `text` as the user's next message.

Answer this component: with `values`, merged over any form's values.
Answers an `acc_ui_ask`, or comes back as the user's next message.
Open a web page after the user confirms.
Open a file on the host.

Action.description: What a tap does. Nothing runs without the user tapping.

icon.description: One emoji shown before the title.

action.description: Runs when the card is tapped.

rows.description:
One array of cells per row, in column order. Cells may hold inline
markdown (`code`, **bold**, links).

detail.description: A second line under the text.

path.description: Absolute path, or relative to the session's working directory.

label.description: What the file is, shown under the path.

x.description: A number, a category label, or an ISO 8601 date.

kind.description: A `pie` uses the first series, with each point's `x` as a slice label.

stacked.description: Stack bar and area series instead of overlapping them.

code.description: Mermaid source: flowchart, sequence, state, class or ER diagram.

src.description: An `https:` URL, a `data:image/...` URL, or an absolute path on the host.

html.description:
A full document or a fragment. Inline all CSS, JS and images: the
sandbox fetches nothing and opens links only after the user confirms.

height.description: Preferred height in points; the content's own height is used if unset.

summary.description: The line shown while it's closed.

name.description: Key of the value in the submitted object: `A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -`.

default.description: Initial value: a string, number or boolean matching `kind`.

multiple.description: A `select` that allows several choices; its value is an array.

Field.description: A form input. Its value is submitted under `name`.

oneOf.description: On/off; the value is a boolean.

value.description: Submitted value; defaults to the label.

id.description:
Stable id for this component, 1-64 of `A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -`. Required for
`acc_ui_ask`, where the answer is keyed by it; make it unique in the
session (`deploy-target-2`).

title.description: Short heading shown above the component.

fallback.description: Plain text shown where the component can't be rendered.

Spec.description: A component for the user: a tree of nodes under `root`.

tools.name: acc_ui_ask
tools.title: Ask with a component
tools.description: Show the user an acc-ui/1 spec with inputs (a form, buttons with submit actions, chips) and wait for their answer, returned as JSON values. Give the spec an id unique in the session. Use it for choices and structured input you need before carrying on.
